articles.title: Ghosts in the Genome: Scientists Uncover Two Hidden Human Ancestors in Our DNA
articles.summary: A new DNA analysis reveals two previously unknown archaic human groups that interbred with our ancestors. One ghost lineage contributed about 1% of modern human DNA and is found in all populations worldwide.

articles.title: Before Buzz Lightyear, There Was Major Matt Mason: Could the 1960s Space Toy Finally Get a Movie?
articles.summary: Mattel's Major Matt Mason, a pioneering astronaut action figure from 1966, is poised for a Hollywood revival. With Tom Hanks once attached and Mattel's film division expanding, the vintage toy may soon get a live-action adaptation.

articles.title: Mars' Honeycomb Mystery: Curiosity Rover Discovers a Sea of Polygonal Fractures
articles.summary: NASA's Curiosity rover has revealed a vast field of honeycomb-like polygons on Mars, each 1.5–3 inches wide. The formations cover the valley floor and climb a 20-foot butte, puzzling scientists about their origin.
